description: Use this when the connected user wants recent AIApply application and preparation status. Return role, company, status, match score, timestamp, and canonical listing link without exposing resumes or contact details. Needs an AIApply account: if the user has not signed in, calling it asks them to sign in or create one.

limit.description: Number of recent applications, from 1 to 20.

name: list_applications

listing_url.description: Null when the link is not on the allowlist.

match_score.description: Null when the job has not been scored.

matched_at.description: When AIApply matched this job to the user, ISO 8601. Null when unknown.

title: Track AIApply applications
